te: The man was poisoned by carbon monoxide in a fire in the garage
de: A man was hospitalized with poisoning by combustion products after a fire in a garage cooperative on Officers Street in Togliatti. According to preliminary data of the EMERCOM of the Samara region, the cause of the fire was a violation of safety rules…

te: Pirates hijack ship with 23 Iranian fishermen
de: Armed pirates have seized the Iranian fishing vessel Azini off the northeastern coast of Somalia. There were 23 people on board, including 21 Iranian nationals and two Somali security guards, according to the Indian Maritime Security Center…
